package.name: cs603_particle_filter_d2
package.description:
COMPSCI 603 Project 3 Deliverable 2
This package implements known-map robot localization using a particle filter in ROS Noetic and Gazebo with the Triton robot model.
Deliverable 2 is a separate package that reuses selected components from Deliverable 1, including: - map preprocessing outputs (metric_map.npy, likelihood_field.npy) - map metadata and occupancy image - position_publisher.py odometry bridge - teleoperation interface - Gazebo world and robot spawn structure
This package uses the starter simulation environment structure (Gazebo + Triton + turtlebot3 house world) and Deliverable 1 map-generation outputs.
How to run the demo:
1) Build the workspace: cd ~/catkin_ws catkin_make source devel/setup.bash
2) Launch the full particle filter demo: roslaunch cs603_particle_filter_d2 particle_filter_d2.launch
This launch file starts: - Gazebo house world - Triton robot spawn - static TF publishers - map_server for RViz occupancy-grid visualization - position_publisher.py for /odom - particle_filter_d2.py - teleop_particle_filter.py - RViz visualization
3) In RViz, the following are visualized: - /map - /pf/particles - /pf/estimated_pose - /scan - TF
4) Use keyboard teleoperation to move the robot and observe: - global particle initialization - convergence of the particle cloud - estimated robot pose tracking on the map
